description: Land Acquisition - Thotagamuwa, Aluvihare, Matale D/S Division, Matale District - Katugasthara, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land lots, claimants, boundaries, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined for Type 4 classification.
